annotations.title: Note rate vs current mortgage rates

description: A note whose rate is below current mortgage rates usually sells at a deeper discount, and this tool gives the gap in percentage points between a note's rate and the latest weekly 30-year fixed mortgage average (Freddie Mac PMMS), with that week's date. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.
name: rate_vs_market
title: Note rate vs current mortgage rates
